Name: New Rabbits and Recolours
Author: Zhuria
Description:
[size=3][color=#00ff00][b]NOTE: Variations are fixed and finally working thanks to help from TheLimeyDragon! If you had the mod installed and variations enabled, your rabbits will now be correctly assigned their skins retroactively.[/b][/color]

I wasn't a big fan of the vanilla rabbits, so I made new sprites! [/size][color=#999999][size=1](8 years ago!)[/size][/color][size=3] There are 10 colour variations for both adults and babies.[/size]

[size=3]You can set your default rabbit colour (rabbits from old saves will use these skins) and enable variations that will be randomly assigned to any rabbit that is born or purchased.
[/size]
[u][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][/u]
[list]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[*][size=3](optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ for easy config [/size]setting management
[*][size=3]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI[/size]
[/list]
